288:- Returning to the usage view after a manual account switch (v158.0): `TryRedirectToUsage`'s post-auth landing whitelist (`/new`, `/chats`, `/chat/`, `/projects`, `/recents`) deliberately excluded the root path, because `/` doubles as the signed-out home page and redirecting it unconditionally loops `/settings/usage → / → /settings/usage`. claude.ai drops a fresh sign-in on `/` about as often as on `/new`, so Switch Account → native "Log out" → sign in as a different user left the panel parked on the home page until the user pressed Refresh. `_sawSignedOutPage` (set whenever the embedded page visits `/login`, `/logout`, `/magic-link` or `/auth`) now promotes `/` to a landing, and `RedirectToUsageIfSettledAsync` requires a non-empty claude.ai `sessionKey` cookie (`HasClaudeSessionCookieAsync`) before navigating — a genuinely signed-out root reads no cookie and is left alone. The flag is cleared as the redirect fires, so a navigate that bounces straight back to `/` cannot re-arm it: one attempt per sign-out. The settle path re-checks `core.Source` both before and after the awaited cookie read, since the await gives the page another chance to move. `/onboarding` is deliberately *not* a landing — an account claude.ai forces through onboarding would ping-pong `/onboarding → /settings/usage` every ~6.5 s (1.5 s settle + 5 s debounce).
289:- Trim restore after Switch Account (`TryRestoreTrim`, v158.0): `SwitchAccountButton_Click` sets `window.__claudeSuppressTrim` so claude.ai's own chrome — and with it the account menu — stays visible. That flag lives on the document, so a full page load clears it by itself, but an SPA route change back to `/settings/usage` does not, leaving the raw settings page (sidebar and all) in the panel. Both `OnNavigationCompleted` and `OnSourceChanged` now clear the flag whenever the source is on `/settings/usage`, ahead of the redirect check.
297:- Switch Account (v300.0, replaces the v158.0 `__claudeSuppressTrim`-in-place flow): the account menu lives in the chat page's sidebar, behind the settings dialog, so un-trimming the usage view no longer exposed it. `BeginSwitchAccountAsync` records the account signature (`ReadAccountSignatureAsync` = `sessionKey|lastActiveOrg` cookies, null when signed out), enters `_switchAccountMode`, navigates to `SwitchAccountUrl` (`/new`) and `TryOpenAccountMenu` (from `OnNavigationCompleted`) clicks `[data-testid="user-menu-button"]` (with fallbacks, 40×200 ms poll). While the mode is on, `TryRedirectToUsage` leaves `/new` alone unless the page was signed out (`_sawSignedOutPage`), and `Reload()` does nothing while the tab is on screen — the background refresh must not yank the user out of the menu. `_switchAccountTimer` (2 s, `OnSwitchAccountTimerTick`, busy-guarded) returns to the usage view when the signature differs from the baseline (organization or account switch without a sign-out), ends the mode when the page is back on the usage view or the core is gone, waits on auth paths, and gives up after `SwitchAccountTimeout` (10 min). Refresh, Sign Out and the off-screen `Reload()` end the mode.
299:- Native-mode composer usage button (v235.0, `Controls/ClaudeCodeControl.ChatUsageIndicator.cs`, `UI/ChatUsageIndicator.cs`, `UI/ChatTranscriptView.xaml` `ComposerUsageButton`/`UsagePopup`): a ring after the composer's Permissions selector, shown only for Claude providers. The popup has two halves: the context window of the chat's last completed turn (`ClaudeStatusLineInput` captured in `CompleteNativeTurn`/`CompleteNativeTurnForSession` into `_mainStatusLine` or `NativeChatSessionState.LastStatusLine`, cleared by Clear Chat), and the plan limits read from the cached `LastUsageJson` (the same numbers as the inline bars, so `NoWeeklyLimit`/`HasExtraUsage` are honored). The ring fills with context %, or with the session limit before any turn has reported a window. `HandleScrapedSnapshot` calls `RefreshChatUsageIndicators()`, so an open popup updates in place. Opening the popup raises `UsageRequested`, handled by `RefreshUsageForIndicatorAsync`: the same account-switch guard the background timer uses first, then `Reload()` when the tab is visible, otherwise `EnsureUsageToolWindowAsync(showWindow:false, updateWindowState:false, activate:false)`, so the tab never appears from a ring click. "See detailed breakdown" (`UsageDetailsRequested`) calls `EnsureUsageToolWindowAsync(showWindow:true)`, the same as the inline bars. The popup's "Updated / Not updated since" line uses `IsUsageSnapshotStale`. Formatting and ring geometry are pure (`ChatUsageIndicator`, unit-tested in `Tests/ChatUsageIndicatorTests.cs`). Popup rows (v236.0): label column `Auto`, value column `*` right-aligned with `CharacterEllipsis`; the border is `MinWidth=280`/`MaxWidth=440` instead of a fixed 280, because a long value ("0% used · Starts with your first message") in the old `*`/`Auto` layout squeezed the label column and drew over "Current session". `UsageNoPlanText` keeps `MaxWidth=256` so its wrapping does not stretch the popup. "Refreshing…" (v236.0): a ring click sets the view's `_usageRefreshing`, so the last line reads "Refreshing…" (snapshot pushes in the meantime only update the stored `_usageUpdatedText`) until the control calls `EndUsageRefresh()` on the clicked transcript when `RefreshUsageForIndicatorAsync` finishes. That task waits for real data: the off-screen path through `RefreshUsageInBackgroundAsync`'s own wait, the visible-tab `Reload()` path on `_indicatorScrapeTcs` (completed in `HandleScrapedSnapshot`, 15 s cap). A click while one is running joins the running `_indicatorRefresh` instead of starting another. Not F5-verified. The popup's wait is capped at `UsageRefreshTextCapMs` (20 s, v268.0): the off-screen path can chain a 10 s silent reload, a WebView2 rebuild (up to 30 s) and another 10 s wait, so "Refreshing…" could sit there over a minute after a fresh sign-in; the refresh itself keeps running and a later snapshot still updates the popup in place. Refresh ring (v276.0): the last line no longer swaps to "Refreshing…" (which hid the time); `UsageUpdatedRow` keeps the "Updated" text and shows `UsageRefreshSpinner` (10 px ring, tooltip "Refreshing…") beside it while `_usageRefreshing`. The rotation is started/stopped with `BeginAnimation` in `ShowUsageUpdatedText` only when the state flips, never by a style trigger (the v265.0 crash). Account line (v300.0): the injected script fetches same-origin `/api/account` once per page load and puts its `email_address` into `UsageSnapshot.AccountEmail`; `BuildChatUsageIndicatorData` passes it on and `UsageAccountText` at the bottom of the popup shows "Account: {0}" (collapsed when empty, e.g. a snapshot cached by an older version). `RefreshLanguage` redoes it.
